final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(circuit_count) AS total_count FROM circuit_counts), proportions AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.circuit_count, 1.0 * c.circuit_count / t.total_count AS circuit_proportion FROM circuit_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(circuit_proportion) AS average_proportion FROM proportions) SELECT p.circuitId, p.circuit_count, p.circuit_proportion, p.circuit_proportion - a.average_proportion AS difference FROM proportions AS p CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_proportion IS NOT NULL AND p.circuit_proportion > a.average_proportion ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
